description.en: The ID of the backup gateway used for downloading backup sets.

description.zh: 备份计划ID，可通过调用[DescribeBackupPlanList](~~2869825~~)接口查看。
description.en: The ID of the backup plan. Call the [DescribeBackupPlanList](~~2869825~~) operation to query the backup plan ID.

description.zh: 备份集下载服务器目录。
description.en: The server directory for downloading backup sets.

description.zh:
备份集下载目标类型 。
> 默认agent：已安装备份网关，目前仅此项。
description.en:
The target type for downloading backup sets.
> Default value: agent, which indicates that a backup gateway is installed. Currently, only this value is supported.

description.zh:
备份集下载目标目录类型，如果是开启自动下载，则必填，取值：
- local
- nas
- ftp
- minio

> 默认为local。
description.en:
The target directory type for downloading backup sets. This parameter is required if automatic download is enabled. Valid values:
- local
- nas
- ftp
- minio

> Default value: local.

description.zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性，防止重复提交请求。
description.en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request and prevent repeated submissions.

description.zh:
备份集下载全量数据格式：
- Native
- SQL
- CSV
- JSON

> 默认 CSV。
description.en:
The format of the full data in the backup set to download. Valid values:
- Native
- SQL
- CSV
- JSON

> Default value: CSV.

description.zh:
备份集下载增量数据格式：
- Native
- SQL
- CSV
- JSON

> 默认Native。
description.en:
The format of the incremental data in the backup set to download. Valid values:
- Native
- SQL
- CSV
- JSON

> Default value: Native.

description.zh: 是否开启自动下载，默认false。
description.en: Specifies whether to enable automatic download. Default value: false.

descriptions.zh: 使用本接口前请先确认备份数据是否存储在DBS的内置OSS上，您可通过调用[DescribeBackupPlanList](~~2869825~~)接口查看BackupStorageType取值情况。
descriptions.en: Before calling this operation, verify that the backup data is stored in the built-in OSS of DBS. Call the [DescribeBackupPlanList](~~2869825~~) operation to check the value of BackupStorageType.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dbs modify-backup-set-download-rules --backup-plan-id dbstooi01xxxx --open-auto-download false --backup-gateway-id 23312323 --full-data-format CSV --increment-data-format Native --backup-set-download-dir test --backup-set-download-target-type agent --backup-set-download-target-type-location local --client-token ETnLKlblzczshOTUbOCzxxxxxxx --api-version 2019-03-06 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun dbs ModifyBackupSetDownloadRules --region cn-hangzhou --BackupSetDownloadDir test --OpenAutoDownload false --BackupPlanId dbstooi01xxxx --IncrementDataFormat Native --BackupGatewayId 23312323 --BackupSetDownloadTargetTypeLocation local --ClientToken ETnLKlblzczshOTUbOCzxxxxxxx --FullDataFormat CSV --BackupSetDownloadTargetType agent
